protocol.energy: mono, centered 10 ms RMS, log positive difference, 11-sample hop (~0.998 ms)
protocol.spectralFlux: mono, 256-sample Hann STFT, log positive spectral difference, 11-sample hop; time bias=3*window/4
protocol.globalDelay: one delay per song/feature estimated on hitobjects outside both dense redline regions and the owner-reviewed interval; range +/-60 ms, step 0.25 ms
protocol.localRefinement: nearest local peak within +/-30 ms of reference+globalDelay; parabolic subframe interpolation; no per-note delay fitting
protocol.denominator: within5msAll includes unmatched references as failures; within5msMatched is conditional and not sufficient alone
protocol.jitterNull: each hitobject shifted by a deterministic nonzero offset in +/-15..95 ms; this tests accidental nearest-peak agreement but preserves neither acoustic labels nor rhythmic structure
protocol.limitation: Residual means agreement with mapper hitobject/redline times, not independently annotated acoustic-onset error. Redlines and hitobjects are oracle priors. No claim of automatic tempo discovery or per-note offset accuracy follows from these metrics alone.
